Ordering is simple

Just a conversation with the baker who will make your cake.

1

Tell Katy your idea

Send an email to likeandflour@gmail.com or message @likeandflour on Instagram with your date, servings and inspiration.

2

She bakes it fresh

Your cake or treats are made fresh to order in Katy's home kitchen — mixed, baked, frosted and decorated by hand, just for your order.

3

Pick up or delivery

Collect your order in Tampa, or have it delivered locally — then slice, serve and take all the credit.
